label: NZDF supports Nelson/Tasman response with geospatial tools
summary: During the Nelson/Tasman emergency, NZDF personnel used the Emergency Operations Centre’s geospatial tools for geotagged task tracking and its Intelligence Common Operating Picture. This helped teams work around road washouts, slips, downed power lines and other obstructions.

sources.label: New Zealand Defence Force, “NZDF support to Nelson/Tasman region”
